text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle.

I'll be honest about the thing that would hold me back if I were you: you've never held one of our pieces. The pictures are made, not photographed, and I'm asking you to trust that the coat is real, that the knit is as soft as it looks. That's a lot to ask of someone I haven't met.

So we carry the risk, not you. Order the coat, or the dress, or the trousers. It's at your door in 7–10 days. Wear it at home, live with it, for up to thirty days. If it isn't right, send it back free and you get every dollar back. No questions, no forms that take an afternoon.

Your 15% is still waiting: WELCOME15 at checkout, on top of the 45% Autumn Sale.

Thank you for reading this far. It means something to a small brand.

Claire
